raw_segments.text: The guards who followed the young woman presented a violent contrast to her, armed as they were
with naked sabers hung at their waists, and long damascene pistols, and bearing a corpse
It was the body of an old man, gorgeously arrayed in the habiliments of Araja, wearing,
as in life, a turban embroidered with pearls, a robe of tissue of silk and gold, a scarf
of cashmere sewed with diamonds, and the magnificent weapons of a Hindu prince.
Next came the musicians and a rearguard of capering fakirs, whose cries sometimes drowned
